svg.title: ElevenLabs voice layer: a private ElevenLabs agent hears your answer with speech to text, thinks with gemini-2.5-flash and asks out loud with text to speech over WebRTC. Four client tools reach our API, which mints a one-conversation token and grades every answer. Dictated questions go through our API to ElevenLabs Speech to Text.
svg.text: THE VOICE COACH · PRIVATE · 10 MINUTE CAP
Same questions as the text quiz. It lights the map as it talks.
